---
title: "Call for Clinical Guideline Experts"
author: "WHO Clinical Management & Operations"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: [cosmo, who.scss]
    logo: assets/who-logo-white.png
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: true
    embed-resources: true
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: envelope
        href: mailto:chaillona@who.int
        aria-label: Contact
params:
  data_dir: "data"          # folder holding dated snapshot sub-folders (data/2026-10-18/...)
  snapshot: ""              # "" = most recent dated sub-folder; or e.g. "2026-10-18"
  show_personal: true       # false = no names / e-mails / free text (use for anything public)
  seats_per_gdg: 20         # target GDG size per guideline (from the call text)
  deadline: "2026-10-19 23:59"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false


suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table); library(plotly); library(DT); library(htmltools); library(bslib)
})

WHO <- c(blue = "#009ADE", navy = "#00205C", sky = "#5BC2E7", green = "#80BC00",
         orange = "#F26829", purple = "#A6228C", amber = "#F2A900", grey = "#8A94A6")
PAL <- unname(WHO[c("blue", "navy", "sky", "green", "orange", "purple", "amber", "grey")])
REGION_NAMES <- c(AFR = "African", AMR = "Americas", SEAR = "South-East Asia",
                  EUR = "European", EMR = "Eastern Mediterranean", WPR = "Western Pacific")

# ---- locate the snapshot -----------------------------------------------------
root <- params$data_dir
snaps <- list.dirs(root, recursive = FALSE)
snaps <- snaps[grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", basename(snaps))]
data_dir <- if (nzchar(params$snapshot)) file.path(root, params$snapshot) else
  if (length(snaps)) sort(snaps, decreasing = TRUE)[1] else root
snapshot <- basename(data_dir)

struct_file <- list.files(data_dir, "^limesurvey_survey_.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)[1]
resp_files  <- list.files(data_dir, "\\.(csv|tsv|xlsx|xls)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (is.na(struct_file)) stop("No limesurvey_survey_*.txt structure file in ", data_dir)
if (!length(resp_files)) stop("No response export (.csv / .xlsx) in ", data_dir)
resp_file <- resp_files[which.max(file.mtime(resp_files))]

# ---- survey structure: code -> label maps --------------------------------------
strip_html <- function(x) trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", gsub("<[^>]+>", " ", x)))
s <- fread(struct_file, sep = "\t", quote = "\"", colClasses = "character", fill = TRUE,
           encoding = "UTF-8", select = c("class", "type/scale", "name", "text"))
setnames(s, "type/scale", "qtype")
answers <- list(); subq <- list(); qtext <- character(); cur <- NA_character_
for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) {
  cl <- s$class[i]; nm <- s$name[i]; tx <- strip_html(s$text[i])
  if (cl == "Q") { cur <- nm; qtext[nm] <- tx }
  else if (cl == "A"  && !is.na(cur)) answers[[cur]][nm] <- tx
  else if (cl == "SQ" && !is.na(cur)) subq[[cur]][nm] <- tx
}
# The form lists age band AO05 as "50–69", overlapping "60–69": almost certainly a typo for 50–59.
age_fix <- identical(unname(answers$G02Q05["AO05"]), "50\u201369")
if (age_fix) answers$G02Q05["AO05"] <- "50\u201359*"

# ---- responses ---------------------------------------------------------------
d <- if (grepl("\\.xlsx?$", resp_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  as.data.table(readxl::read_excel(resp_file, col_types = "text"))
} else {
  fread(resp_file, colClasses = "character", encoding = "UTF-8",
        na.strings = c("", "NA"), check.names = FALSE)
}
nm <- sub("^\ufeff", "", names(d))
nm <- sub("^([A-Za-z0-9_]+(\\[[^]]*\\])?)\\.\\s.*$", "\\1", nm)   # "CODE. question text" headings
nm <- sub("^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\\[([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\\]$", "\\1_\\2", nm)  # G01Q22[SQ001] -> G01Q22_SQ001
nm <- trimws(nm)
std <- c("Response ID" = "id", "Date submitted" = "submitdate", "Last page" = "lastpage",
         "Date started" = "startdate", "Date last action" = "datestamp")
nm[nm %in% names(std)] <- std[nm[nm %in% names(std)]]

# --- headings written as question text instead of codes ------------------------------
# LimeSurvey can export "Full/abbreviated question text" headings, e.g.
#   "Which guideline(s) (one or more): [Sepsis]", "filecount - Please upload your CV ...".
# Map those back to codes using the question texts from the structure file.
norm <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", tolower(strip_html(x)))
qrows <- s[class == "Q"]
E <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(qrows)), function(i) {
  q <- qrows$name[i]; qt <- norm(strip_html(qrows$text[i]))
  rows <- list(data.table(code = q, qn = qt, sn = ""))
  if (!is.null(subq[[q]])) rows <- c(rows, list(
    data.table(code = paste0(q, "_", names(subq[[q]])), qn = qt, sn = norm(subq[[q]])),
    data.table(code = paste0(q, "_other"), qn = qt, sn = "other")))
  if (identical(qrows$qtype[i], "|")) rows <- c(rows, list(data.table(code = paste0(q, "_filecount"), qn = paste0("filecount", qt), sn = "")))
  rbindlist(rows)
}))
known <- c(E$code, "id", "submitdate", "lastpage", "startdate", "datestamp", "startlanguage", "seed", "token", "refurl", "ipaddr")
for (j in which(!nm %in% known)) {
  h <- nm[j]; sub_h <- ""
  m <- regmatches(h, regexec("^(.*?)\\s*\\[([^]]*)\\]\\s*$", h))[[1]]
  if (length(m)) { h <- m[2]; sub_h <- m[3] }
  hn <- norm(sub("^filecount\\s*-\\s*", "filecount", h)); want <- norm(sub_h)
  if (nchar(hn) < 6) next
  hit <- E[sn == want & (startsWith(qn, hn) | startsWith(hn, qn)) & !code %in% nm]
  if (nrow(hit)) nm[j] <- hit$code[1]
}
setnames(d, nm)
need <- c("Q1", "G01Q14", "G02Q06", "G01Q22_SQ001")
if (!all(need %in% names(d))) stop(
  "Could not find the question columns in ", basename(resp_file), " (missing: ",
  paste(setdiff(need, names(d)), collapse = ", "), ").\nColumn headings seen: ",
  paste(head(names(d), 40), collapse = " | "),
  "\nRe-export from LimeSurvey with 'Question code' headings, or send these headings over.")

g <- function(code) if (code %in% names(d)) as.character(d[[code]]) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(d))
blank <- function(x) is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""
decode <- function(x, q) { lab <- answers[[q]]; i <- !blank(x) & x %in% names(lab); x[i] <- lab[x[i]]; x[blank(x)] <- NA; x }
picked <- function(x) { x <- toupper(trimws(x)); !is.na(x) & x != "" & !x %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE", "NOT SELECTED") }
yn <- function(x) { x <- toupper(trimws(x)); fifelse(x %in% c("Y", "YES"), "Yes", fifelse(x %in% c("N", "NO"), "No", NA_character_)) }
has_file <- function(code) {
  fc <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(g(paste0(code, "_filecount"))))
  js <- g(code)
  (!is.na(fc) & fc > 0) | (!blank(js) & nchar(js) > 2 & trimws(js) != "[]")
}
parse_dt <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x); x[x == ""] <- NA
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.POSIXct(x, tz = "UTC", optional = TRUE,
           tryFormats = c("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", "%d.%m.%Y %H:%M", "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M", "%Y-%m-%d")))
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)); k <- is.na(out) & !is.na(num)          # Excel serial dates
  out[k] <- as.POSIXct(num[k] * 86400, origin = "1899-12-30", tz = "UTC")
  out
}
multi <- function(q) {                                   # multiple-choice -> logical matrix
  sq <- subq[[q]]
  m <- vapply(names(sq), function(k) picked(g(paste0(q, "_", k))), logical(nrow(d)))
  if (is.null(dim(m))) m <- matrix(m, nrow = nrow(d))
  colnames(m) <- unname(sq); m
}
collapse <- function(m, extra = NULL) {
  out <- apply(m, 1, function(r) paste(colnames(m)[r], collapse = "; "))
  if (!is.null(extra)) out <- ifelse(blank(extra), out, ifelse(out == "", extra, paste0(out, "; ", extra)))
  out[out == ""] <- NA; out
}
ord <- function(x, q) factor(x, levels = unname(answers[[q]]))

GL <- multi("G01Q22"); gl_names <- colnames(GL)
EX <- multi("G01Q17"); QU <- multi("G01Q23")
countries <- fread("assets/who_countries.csv", encoding = "UTF-8")

started  <- parse_dt(g("startdate"))
submitted <- parse_dt(g("submitdate"))
is_complete <- if ("submitdate" %in% names(d)) !is.na(submitted) else rep(TRUE, nrow(d))

gender <- decode(g("G02Q06"), "G02Q06")
position <- decode(g("G01Q16"), "G01Q16")
position_full <- ifelse(!blank(g("G01Q21")), paste0(position, " (", g("G01Q21"), ")"), position)
email_col <- grep("e-?mail", names(d), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]

a <- data.table(
  .orig     = seq_len(nrow(d)),
  id        = g("id"),
  complete  = is_complete,
  lastpage  = g("lastpage"),
  started   = started,
  submitted = submitted,
  family    = trimws(g("G01Q14")),
  first     = trimws(g("G01Q15")),
  email     = if (!is.na(email_col)) g(email_col) else NA_character_,
  guidelines = collapse(GL),
  country   = decode(g("Q1"), "Q1"),
  gender    = gender,
  gender_txt = ifelse(!blank(g("G01Q25")), paste0(gender, ": ", g("G01Q25")), gender),
  age       = ord(sub("^50\u201369$", "50\u201359*", decode(g("G02Q05"), "G02Q05")), "G02Q05"),
  position  = position,
  position_full = position_full,
  experience = collapse(EX, g("G01Q24")),
  years     = ord(decode(g("G01Q18"), "G01Q18"), "G01Q18"),
  qualifications = collapse(QU, g("G01Q23_other")),
  humanitarian = yn(g("G01Q29")),
  prior_gdg    = yn(g("G01Q19")),
  local_gl     = yn(g("G01Q28")),
  other_who    = yn(g("G01Q20")),
  cv  = has_file("G01Q26"),
  doi = has_file("G01Q04"),
  cu  = has_file("G02Q21"),
  motivation = g("G01Q01")
)
a <- merge(a, countries, by = "country", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
setorder(a, .orig)                                   # keep export order, aligned with GL/EX/QU
a[, region := factor(who_region, levels = names(REGION_NAMES))]
# possible duplicate = same name + same country, or same e-mail, among complete applications
a[, name_key := paste(tolower(gsub("[^[:alpha:]]", "", paste(family, first))), country)]
a[, mail_key := tolower(trimws(email))]
dup <- function(k) !blank(k) & (duplicated(k) | duplicated(k, fromLast = TRUE))
a[, duplicate := FALSE]
a[complete == TRUE, duplicate := dup(name_key) | dup(mail_key)]
ok <- a$complete
ap <- a[ok]; GLc <- GL[ok, , drop = FALSE]; EXc <- EX[ok, , drop = FALSE]; QUc <- QU[ok, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- headline figures ------------------------------------------------------------
n_started  <- nrow(a)
n_complete <- nrow(ap)
pct <- function(x, n = length(x)) if (n == 0) "\u2013" else paste0(round(100 * sum(x, na.rm = TRUE) / n), "%")
n_countries <- uniqueN(na.omit(ap$country))
n_regions   <- uniqueN(na.omit(ap$who_region))
seats <- params$seats_per_gdg
deadline <- as.POSIXct(params$deadline, tz = "Europe/Zurich")
days_left <- ceiling(as.numeric(difftime(deadline, Sys.time(), units = "days")))

vb <- function(title, value, sub = NULL, icon = "people", cls = NULL) {
  value_box(title = title, value = value, showcase = tags$i(class = paste0("bi bi-", icon)), showcase_layout = showcase_top_right(width = 0.25),
            if (!is.null(sub)) p(sub), class = cls, theme = NULL)
}
plt <- function(p) config(p, displaylogo = FALSE,
  modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d", "autoScale2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d", "pan2d", "zoom2d"))
lay <- function(p, ..., margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 10))
  layout(p, font = list(family = "Arial", color = "#1F2A44", size = 12),
         paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", margin = margin, ...)
hbar <- function(labels, values, color = WHO["blue"], total = n_complete) {
  o <- order(values); lab <- labels[o]; v <- values[o]
  plot_ly(x = v, y = factor(lab, levels = lab), type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = color), text = paste0(v, " (", round(100 * v / max(total, 1)), "%)"),
          textposition = "auto", cliponaxis = FALSE, hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x}<extra></extra>") |>
    lay(xaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#E3E9F0"), yaxis = list(title = "")) |> plt()
}
```

# Overview

## Row {height="auto"}

```{r}
layout_column_wrap(
  width = "200px", fill = FALSE,
  vb("Complete applications", n_complete, paste0(n_started, " started \u00b7 ", pct(ok), " completed"), "person-check"),
  vb("Countries", n_countries, paste0(n_regions, " of 6 WHO regions"), "globe2", "vb-navy"),
  vb("Women", pct(ap$gender == "Female"), paste0(sum(ap$gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE), " applicants"), "gender-female", "vb-navy"),
  vb("Lived experience", sum(EXc[, "Person with lived experience"]), "persons with lived experience", "heart-pulse", "vb-green"),
  vb("CV + DOI uploaded", pct(ap$cv & ap$doi), "documentation complete", "file-earmark-check", "vb-green"),
  vb(if (days_left >= 0) "Days to deadline" else "Call closed", if (days_left >= 0) days_left else format(deadline, "%d %b"),
     paste("Deadline", format(deadline, "%d %b %Y %H:%M"), "Geneva"), "calendar-event", "vb-amber")
)
```

    n <- sum(GLc[, gn])
    vb(gn, n, sprintf("%.1f applicants per seat (target %d)", n / seats, seats), "clipboard2-pulse")
  })))

```{r}
#| title: Applications over time
ts <- ap[!is.na(submitted), .N, by = .(day = as.Date(submitted))][order(day)]
if (nrow(ts)) {
  ts[, cum := cumsum(N)]
  plot_ly(ts, x = ~day) |>
    add_bars(y = ~N, name = "Per day", marker = list(color = WHO["sky"]),
             hovertemplate = "%{x|%d %b}: %{y}<extra></extra>") |>
    add_lines(y = ~cum, name = "Cumulative", yaxis = "y2", line = list(color = WHO["navy"], width = 3),
              hovertemplate = "Total by %{x|%d %b}: %{y}<extra></extra>") |>
    lay(xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "Per day", gridcolor = "#E3E9F0"),
        yaxis2 = list(title = "Cumulative", overlaying = "y", side = "right", showgrid = FALSE, rangemode = "tozero"),
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = 1.1), margin = list(l = 10, r = 55, t = 30, b = 10),
        shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = as.Date(deadline), x1 = as.Date(deadline), y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
                           yref = "paper", line = list(color = WHO["orange"], dash = "dot"))),
        annotations = list(list(x = as.Date(deadline), y = 1, yref = "paper", text = "Deadline",
                                showarrow = FALSE, xanchor = "right", font = list(color = WHO["orange"])))) |> plt()
} else p("No submission dates in this export.")
```

```{r}
#| title: Applicants by guideline and WHO region
long <- rbindlist(lapply(gl_names, function(gn) ap[GLc[, gn], .(guideline = gn, region)]))
long[, region := factor(ifelse(is.na(region), "Unknown", as.character(region)), levels = c(names(REGION_NAMES), "Unknown"))]
tab <- long[, .N, by = .(guideline, region)]
p <- plot_ly()
for (k in seq_along(levels(tab$region))) {
  r <- levels(tab$region)[k]; t <- tab[region == r]
  if (nrow(t)) p <- add_bars(p, data = t, x = ~N, y = ~guideline, name = r, orientation = "h",
                             marker = list(color = c(PAL, "#C7CED9")[k]),
                             hovertemplate = paste0(r, ": %{x}<extra>%{y}</extra>"))
}
p |> lay(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = "#E3E9F0"),
         yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = rev(gl_names)),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.12, traceorder = "normal")) |> plt()
```

#| title: Gender by guideline
gtab <- rbindlist(lapply(gl_names, function(gn) ap[GLc[, gn], .N, by = .(gender)][, guideline := gn]))
gtab[is.na(gender), gender := "Not answered"]
gtab[, share := N / sum(N), by = guideline]
gcol <- c(Female = WHO[["blue"]], Male = WHO[["navy"]], "Prefer not to specify" = "#C7CED9",
          "Prefer to specify" = WHO[["purple"]], "Not answered" = "#E3E9F0")
p <- plot_ly()
for (gg in intersect(names(gcol), unique(gtab$gender))) {
  t <- gtab[gender == gg]
  p <- add_bars(p, data = t, x = ~share, y = ~guideline, name = gg, orientation = "h",
                marker = list(color = gcol[[gg]]), text = ~paste0(round(100 * share), "%"),
                textposition = "inside", hovertemplate = paste0(gg, ": %{customdata} (%{x:.0%})<extra>%{y}</extra>"),
                customdata = ~N)
}
p |> lay(barmode = "stack", uniformtext = list(minsize = 10, mode = "hide"),
         xaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1)),
         yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = rev(gl_names)),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2, traceorder = "normal")) |> plt()

#| title: Where applicants are based
mk <- function(sel) ap[sel & !is.na(iso3), .N, by = .(iso3, country)]
sets <- c(list(`All guidelines` = rep(TRUE, n_complete)), setNames(lapply(gl_names, function(gn) GLc[, gn]), gl_names))
zmax <- max(1, mk(rep(TRUE, n_complete))$N)
p <- plot_ly()
for (k in seq_along(sets)) {
  t <- mk(sets[[k]])
  p <- add_trace(p, type = "choropleth", locations = t$iso3, z = t$N, text = t$country,
                 locationmode = "ISO-3", name = names(sets)[k], visible = k == 1, zmin = 0, zmax = zmax,
                 colorscale = list(c(0, "#D6EEF9"), c(0.35, "#5BC2E7"), c(0.7, "#009ADE"), c(1, "#00205C")),
                 marker = list(line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 0.5)),
                 colorbar = list(title = "Applicants", thickness = 12, len = 0.6),
                 hovertemplate = "%{text}: %{z}<extra></extra>")
}
btns <- lapply(seq_along(sets), function(k) list(label = names(sets)[k], method = "restyle",
                                                 args = list("visible", as.list(seq_along(sets) == k))))
p |> lay(geo = list(projection = list(type = "natural earth"), showframe = FALSE, showcoastlines = FALSE,
                    showland = TRUE, landcolor = "#ECEFF3", countrycolor = "#FFFFFF", showcountries = TRUE,
                    bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", lataxis = list(range = c(-58, 85))),
         updatemenus = list(list(type = "buttons", direction = "right", x = 0, y = 1.07, xanchor = "left",
                                 buttons = btns, bgcolor = "#FFFFFF", bordercolor = WHO["blue"])),
         margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 30, b = 0)) |> plt()

#| title: By WHO region
rt <- rbindlist(lapply(c("All", gl_names), function(gn) {
  sel <- if (gn == "All") rep(TRUE, n_complete) else GLc[, gn]
  ap[sel, .N, by = region][, guideline := gn]
}))
rt[, region_lab := ifelse(is.na(region), "Unknown", paste0(REGION_NAMES[as.character(region)], " (", region, ")"))]
w <- dcast(rt, region_lab ~ guideline, value.var = "N", fill = 0)
for (gn in setdiff(c("All", gl_names), names(w))) set(w, j = gn, value = 0L)
setcolorder(w, c("region_lab", "All", gl_names)); setnames(w, "region_lab", "WHO region")
setorderv(w, "All", -1)
datatable(w, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = FALSE),
          class = "compact stripe") |>
  formatStyle(c("All", gl_names), background = styleColorBar(c(0, max(w$All)), "#BFE6F7"),
              backgroundSize = "95% 70%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", backgroundPosition = "center")

```{r}
#| title: !expr paste0("Complete applications (", n_complete, ")", if (!params$show_personal) " \u2014 personal data hidden" else "")
tbl <- ap[order(-as.numeric(submitted))][, .(
  ID = id,
  Submitted = format(submitted, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
  `Family name` = family, `First name` = first, Email = email,
  `Guideline(s)` = guidelines, Country = country, `WHO region` = who_region,
  Position = position_full, `Experience areas` = experience, `Years exp.` = as.character(years),
  Gender = gender_txt, `Age group` = as.character(age), Qualifications = qualifications,
  Humanitarian = humanitarian, `Prior WHO GDG` = prior_gdg, `Other WHO group` = other_who,
  `Local guideline work` = local_gl,
  CV = fifelse(cv, "Yes", "No"), DOI = fifelse(doi, "Yes", "No"), `Confidentiality` = fifelse(cu, "Yes", "No"),
  `Possible duplicate` = fifelse(duplicate, "Yes", ""),
  Motivation = motivation)]
if (all(is.na(tbl$Email))) tbl[, Email := NULL]
if (!params$show_personal) tbl[, intersect(c("Family name", "First name", "Email", "Motivation", "Gender"), names(tbl)) := NULL]

long_cols <- which(names(tbl) %in% c("Motivation", "Experience areas", "Qualifications")) - 1
fname <- paste0("GDG_expert_applications_", snapshot)
datatable(
  tbl, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", extensions = "Buttons", fillContainer = TRUE,
  class = "compact stripe hover nowrap",
  options = list(
    dom = "Bfrtip", pageLength = 50, scrollX = TRUE, scrollY = "520px", scrollCollapse = TRUE,
    buttons = list(
      list(extend = "csv",   text = "\u2b07 CSV",   filename = fname, exportOptions = list(orthogonal = "export")),
      list(extend = "excel", text = "\u2b07 Excel", filename = fname, title = "", exportOptions = list(orthogonal = "export")),
      list(extend = "copy",  text = "Copy", exportOptions = list(orthogonal = "export"))),
    columnDefs = list(list(targets = long_cols, render = JS(
      "function(d, type) {",
      "  if (d === null || d === undefined) return '';",
      "  if (type !== 'display') return d;",
      "  var s = String(d); var esc = s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/\"/g,'&quot;').replace(/</g,'&lt;');",
      "  return s.length > 60 ? '<span title=\"' + esc + '\">' + esc.substr(0, 60) + '\u2026</span>' : esc;",
      "}")))
  ),
  escape = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| title: Experience with WHO / guideline processes
yv <- list(`Humanitarian setting` = ap$humanitarian, `Prior WHO GDG member` = ap$prior_gdg,
           `Other WHO expert group` = ap$other_who, `Local guideline development / adaptation` = ap$local_gl)
yt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(yv), function(k) data.table(item = k, ans = c("Yes", "No"),
                N = c(sum(yv[[k]] == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), sum(yv[[k]] == "No", na.rm = TRUE)))))
yt[, share := N / sum(N), by = item]
plot_ly(yt[ans == "Yes"], x = ~share, y = ~item, type = "bar", orientation = "h", name = "Yes",
        marker = list(color = WHO["green"]), text = ~paste0(N, " (", round(100 * share), "%)"), textposition = "inside",
        hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{text}<extra>Yes</extra>") |>
  add_bars(data = yt[ans == "No"], x = ~share, y = ~item, name = "No", marker = list(color = "#DCE3EB"),
           text = ~paste0(N), textposition = "inside", hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{text}<extra>No</extra>") |>
  lay(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1)), yaxis = list(title = ""),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2)) |> plt()
```

## Row {height="auto"}

```{r}
#| title: Composition by guideline (complete applications)
comp <- rbindlist(lapply(gl_names, function(gn) {
  s <- GLc[, gn]; x <- ap[s]; e <- EXc[s, , drop = FALSE]
  r <- table(factor(x$who_region, levels = names(REGION_NAMES)))
  data.table(Guideline = gn, Applicants = nrow(x), `Per seat` = round(nrow(x) / seats, 1),
             Women = pct(x$gender == "Female"), Countries = uniqueN(na.omit(x$country)),
             AFR = r[["AFR"]], AMR = r[["AMR"]], SEAR = r[["SEAR"]], EUR = r[["EUR"]], EMR = r[["EMR"]], WPR = r[["WPR"]],
             `Lived exp.` = sum(e[, "Person with lived experience"]),
             `Ethics / equity` = sum(e[, "Medical ethics and health equity"]),
             Nurses = sum(e[, "Nurse"]),
             `Prior GDG` = sum(x$prior_gdg == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
             `CV + DOI` = pct(x$cv & x$doi))
}))
datatable(comp, rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe",
          options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE, scrollX = TRUE)) |>
  formatStyle(c("AFR", "AMR", "SEAR", "EUR", "EMR", "WPR"),
              backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(0, 2), c("#FDE2D6", "#FFF4D1", "transparent"))) |>
  formatStyle("Lived exp.", backgroundColor = styleInterval(0, c("#FDE2D6", "transparent")))
```
